title: Bithumb Spot Ticker
description: Schema for a single ticker entry returned by the /spot/ticker endpoint.

c.description: Last price in the past 24 hours

h.description: High price in the past 24 hours

l.description: Low price in the past 24 hours

p.description: Price change percentage in the past 24 hours

v.description: Volume (deal quantity) in the past 24 hours
